description: Recruiter Elena sent a cashier's check of $3,500 to purchase home office equipment from a specified vendor and demanded immediate wire refund of the $1,200 difference before the check cleared.
Interview conducted entirely on Telegram. Afterwards, they demanded an upfront $250 background verification and security portal registration fee.
Received an unsolicited job offer without applying. Required uploading unredacted social security card and passport photos to a non-HTTPS web form before any formal offer or interview.
